title: The first matching element in a Guava int array
summary: The public release must return the first occurrence or minus one, terminate normally and preserve an already allocated array.

change.description: Compare the released search with a deliberately constructed last-match traversal.

notes: The two bounded milestones quantify over all signed 32-bit array elements and targets. The length-independent objective admits every non-null, already allocated Java int array. A prefix without a match and the decreasing measure length minus cursor are the proposed inductive assertions.
